stage_scope: Baseline stages from earlier v1 four-way campaign, candidate stages collected independently; no profiling latency substituted for normal requests.
video_and_audio: All formal MP4 bytes match both fresh v1 control and original BF16 videos; this implies identical encoded video/audio and decoded pixels/PCM for the same decoder.

gate_timelines.label: v1 overlap
gate_timelines.method: GPU7 step3layer0. Gate-v2 identity from gate NVTX and CUDA API correlation; previous gate and fused QKV inferred from model source order. RDMA windows span the opening-barrier end to closing-barrier start and may include completion/scheduling waits: gate_overlap_ms is overlap with these windows, not measured PCIe payload-active duration. Raw sampled counters, not interval averages. Diagnostic trace timings, not normal-request speed claims.

compile_drift.note: Initial cache-cold v1 control is excluded from speed/lossless claims: its output changed with gate overlap disabled. Six previously selected RMSNorm reduction configurations differed. Reusing a copy of the original compiler cache restored the original MP4; formal A/B pins and checks those selections.
